# 3 Maccabees Chapter 7 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Alexandrinus) | **Section:** Liberation, Celebration, and Return

---

**1** When the king had sent this letter to the generals throughout the cities with these instructions, he released the Jews to return to their homes.

**2** He gave orders that soldiers stationed in the various cities were to show the Jews respect and honor.

**3** He commanded that all property taken from the Jews was to be restored to them in full, and anyone holding any of their goods was to return everything at once and without any tricks.

**4** Furthermore, anyone who had committed a crime against the Jews was to be punished, and anyone who had spoken against them was to receive what they deserved.

**5** He urged all his officials to treat the Jews in their territory with every kindness and goodwill.

**6** After this letter had been issued, the Jews gathered in a suitable place with great joy and celebrated with prayers and songs of praise.

**7** They declared that day a joyful festival, a day of great gladness, calling it a day of great salvation.

**8** The king also granted them a three-day celebration, with a great feast, singing, and toasting.

**9** And the Jews who had been taken to various parts of Egypt returned home with joy and gladness.

**10** Delivered from death itself, they went back to their families and their homes.

**11** From that day on they resolved to celebrate this day as a great festival for all the years they lived in Egypt.

**12** They also sent letters to their brothers in Jerusalem reporting everything that had happened, and calling the day a festival.

**13** Everyone rejoiced together over the great things that God had done for his people Israel, demonstrating that he was with them and watching over them.

**14** The delivered Jews gathered and resolved to observe this festival in perpetuity in their communities, wherever they might live.

**15** They called it the Phruraia, the feast of salvation, a day of joy and gladness.

**16** And the glory of the God of Israel was proclaimed throughout all the people.

**17** For the God of Israel is the God who works wonders for his people and who delivered them from destruction.

**18** Blessed is the Lord who saved Israel from all its troubles.

**19** And the people of Israel praised God with songs of thanksgiving and joyful praise.

**20** Great is the glory of the God of Israel, the one God who alone does wondrous things among his people.
